newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle trade up $1 at $70 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle trade up $1 at $70 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active at mid-morning, slow later, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 higher than last week. Inquiry and demand good at mid-morning, fair later.

Sales confirmed on 32,200 slaughter steers and 23,400 slaughter heifers Friday. This week's total confirmed sales as of 10:00 A.M. Friday, only 30,000 head including 18,100 head or about 60 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1140-1350 lbs 70.00; couple pens with end cutting bulls 69.00; few Select with end Choice 1125 lbs 69.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1030-1200 lbs 70.00; couple pens mixed Commerical to Choice 1110-1225 lb heifers and heiferettes 68.00- 70.00.
